title: Bound on an in-range list entry
statement: Let $l$ be a list of integers and let $U$ be an integer. If every entry of $l$ has absolute value at most $U$, then for every natural number $i$ with $i<\operatorname{length}(l)$, the entry at position $i$ has absolute value at most $U$.
hypotheses_covered: Every entry of $l$ has absolute value at most $U$
